results.title: Wladimir Klitschko breaks silence on sudden death of ex Hayden Panettiere after she gave him custody of their daughter
results.description: WLADIMIR Klitschko has broken his silence following the sudden death of his ex-fiancé Hayden Panettiere. The beloved US actress, who was nominated for two Golden Globes, died on Sunday, her heartbroken family confirmed.
